interaction_phrase: an international team from the University of the Witwatersrand, Johannesburg, and ICFO
occurrence_sentence: Nature Communications published research by an international team from the University of the Witwatersrand, Johannesburg, and ICFO – The Institute of Photonic Sciences, Spain, which demonstrates the teleportation-like transport of "patterns" of light – this is the first approach that can transport images across a network without physically sending the image, and a crucial step towards realising a quantum network for high-dimensional entangled states.
target_actor: ICFO – The Institute of Photonic Sciences
